content: We initialize word embeddings using the 300-dimension GloVe vectors supplied by Pennington et al., ( BIBREF28 ), which were trained on 840 billion tokens from the Common Crawl. For each pair of domains, the vocabulary consists of the top 10000 most frequent words. For words in the vocabulary but not present in the pre-trained embeddings, we randomly initialize them.
